race.comment: PATTERA (6) turned things around last start and landed the prize over 1000m at Mendooran. Meeting a tougher field but on his best form he is one of the key runners. ANGIE'S SISTER (4) is knocking on the door and is desperate to break through soon. Expect Gallagher to bounce straight to the front on his mare and prove tough to run down. ENCHAANTED (8) last appeared 47 days ago over 1100m at Gatton when she finished sixth. This is her first run for the David J Smith stable and if she can recapture her best form she's a big hope. DESIROUS (5) didn't fire a shot first-up at Scone but will find this easier and is sure to have come on from that. Not taking lightly.
